title: Definitions
bodyText:
. As used in this part:

"Client" means a child or adolescent who is receiving services from the child and adolescent mental health division.

"Division" means the child and adolescent mental health division of the department of health.
bodyHtml:
[§321-178]  Definitions.  As used in this part:

     "Client" means a child or adolescent who is receiving services from the child and adolescent mental health division.

     "Division" means the child and adolescent mental health division of the department of health. [L 2025, c 178, §2]
